entities.name: Canonicalize the project work lifecycle
entities.summary: Make model/work the only lifecycle authority and derive stable feature artifacts, acceptance dispatch, and lifecycle views from one typed feature record.

acceptance: One canonical work entity owns each feature ID and stable artifact resolution derives from it
Work, contract, review, evidence, question, and deployment states remain separate
Plans and design contracts use stable lifecycle-neutral paths without aliases
Feature acceptance dispatch and changed-path selection use canonical resolution
Generated lifecycle views are deterministic projections with source provenance
